intended_object: A specific homeomorphism used inside the proof of the classification of surfaces. It goes from the polygon cell of the selected face to a parametrized gluing of child disks, and it covers the degenerate P2 cut case where the left part is empty. This is read off the docstring, the name and the module context.
explanation: The definition chains three homeomorphisms: a cyclic rotation of the polygon cell, a local homeomorphism for the degenerate disk, and a transport along the fact that the left length is zero. It is built for one particular case of a cut-and-paste step in the proof (a P2 cut with orientation false, an empty left list and a nonempty right list). It is a proof device specific to how the library encodes surfaces as finite cyclic presentations, and the literature has no standard object it is meant to formalize. So it is not a mathematical object in the sense of this task.
